per_hop.query:
SELECT p1.name AS general_manager_name, p2.name AS player_drafted_higher_than_Steve_Little, 
       h1.inducted_college_football_hall_of_fame, h2.inducted_pro_football_hall_of_fame, 
       ps.role, ps.team
FROM personnel ps
JOIN general_managers p1 ON ps.general_manager_id = p1.id
JOIN players p2 ON p2.team = ps.team AND p2.drafted_position < (SELECT drafted_position FROM players WHERE name = 'Steve Little')
LEFT JOIN hall_of_fame_inductees h1 ON p2.name = h1.name AND h1.hall_of_fame_type = 'College Football Hall of Fame'
LEFT JOIN hall_of_fame_inductees h2 ON p2.name = h2.name AND h2.hall_of_fame_type = 'Pro Football Hall of Fame'
WHERE ps.name = 'Philip Savage' AND ps.role = 'Director of Player Personnel' AND ps.team = 'Baltimore Ravens';
